quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Announces New Collaboration to Advance Single (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 10x Genomics announced a multi-project research collaboration with Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center (Fred Hutch) to advance single cell and spatial technologies in solid tumors and hematologic malignancies; the company says it is 10x's first clinical research initiative to extend beyond solid tumors into blood cancers. The first project intends to use the Flex Apex and Xenium platforms, with plans to expand to the Atera platform, on tumor samples from patients with advanced bladder cancer treated with antibody-drug conjugates, immune checkpoint inhibitors and other therapies, to correlate drug target expression and tumor microenvironment features with treatment response and explore biomarkers that could one day help inform therapy selection. The second project intends to use Flex Apex to investigate residual disease detection in acute myeloid leukemia (AML). The company says the collaboration, together with 10x's planned CLIA-certified laboratory, builds the foundation for potential future diagnostic applications in oncology and autoimmune disease, and the two plan to build a framework for future clinical reporting. CEO Serge Saxonov: single cell and spatial biology let us look directly at the biology that drives treatment response, 'and we believe that's the missing foundation for precision oncology.'
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: research collaborator (bladder cancer biomarkers and AML residual disease detection)
